title: Amelia found able to spell, read minds, see spirits and know other languages

tellings.quote: discovered that Amelia was in there and could spell and then that she could read her mind and then that she was seeing stuff that that Mora the mother couldn't see she could see spirits and ghosts and then she started saying that she knew other languages and she could identify hieroglyphics and knew Hebrew and Portuguese and Spanish

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about children said to read minds, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a girl named Amelia and her mother, Mora, in the American Midwest around 2020 and 2021. Dickens says that Mora found out Amelia could spell, then that she could read her mother's mind, then that she saw spirits and ghosts her mother could not see. Amelia also began saying she knew other languages, Hebrew, Portuguese and Spanish, and could read ancient Egyptian picture writing, which if true would point to a kind of knowing beyond ordinary learning.
